text: A muscular male figure with a lean build, tanned skin, and long blonde hair in a single braid down his back. His face is angular with a stern expression, showing teeth slightly. He wears a dark red loincloth with a gold circular belt buckle, and two white tusks protrude from his upper lip. Kneeling low, he grips a spear with both hands, angled forward. Behind him, other figures lie motionless on the ground in a dimly lit, rocky landscape.
